services.desc: A trip for every angler - Strike Charters offers four charter options designed to fit your schedule and goals on the water. Whether you're looking for a quick morning bite or a full day exploring the Cape Fear coast. Every trip includes all rods, reels, bait, tackle, and fishing licenses. Just show up and fish. All skill levels welcome - From kids catching their first fish to experienced anglers chasing trophy Redfish and Speckled Trout, Captain Drew tailors each trip to your group. Up to 4 anglers per charter with flexible AM or PM departures. blurb: Strike Charters offers some of the best Wilmington NC inshore fishing you'll find anywhere on the Cape Fear Coast. The waters surrounding Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach, Fort Fisher, Bald Head Island, and Oak Island are home to red drum, speckled trout, flounder, black drum, sheepshead, and many more sport fish species.
